speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis.

The clinical picture of a chronic productive cough with thick, purulent sputum in a non-smoker, despite recurrent bronchitis diagnoses, is highly suggestive of bronchiectasis rather than simple chronic bronchitis. I will request a Chest CT to confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of the disease.
